mask_probe.note: Low change for final/dp_none means the missing-aware DP keeps its state through an occlusion; ~1.0 for missing->D shows the naive rule rewrites the window. Structural, not accuracy.

full_match_diagnostics.role: GT-free structural checks only; no accuracy claim

interpretation.bytetrack_botsort: Not run: the bundle has point tracking and metadata only. No video and no bounding-box detections are present, so ByteTrack/BoT-SORT (bbox + confidence + detector) are not applicable.
interpretation.decision_rule: Component active only if synthetic delta >= 0.04 with paired 90% CI excluding 0 in >= 2/3 seeds. Public window cannot support an improvement claim.
known_limitations: Public window: 17 GT possessions, CI width ~0.3, not representative.
Bootstrap holds n_pred fixed; intervals for count-changing arms are optimistic.
The alpha=0.04 / CI rule is borrowed from synthetic work, not calibrated here.
Team identity switches are not repaired; the ATD team label is used as-is.
Synthetic dead states are placed on observable stoppages, so evidence gains there are built in by construction.
No full-match GT: ranking performance cannot be verified before the deadline.
experiments/ is untracked in git; script sha256 is the only provenance.

criterion.rule: GT-free: predicted full-match possession count must lie in the band; among valid lambdas pick the one closest to the centre. No ground truth is used.

official_scorer.note: Same possession_metrics module; identical numbers verify file and pipeline consistency, not independent validation.

definition.description: nearest player, D where the ball is missing
majority vote +/-125 then force D on final evidence
majority vote +/-125 then force D on long_missing evidence

public_window.role: validation only; no arm or parameter may be selected from these numbers

synthetic_autocorr.role: mechanism only: autocorrelated confusion (p_start 0.01, mean episode 2 s) is a milder form of autocorrelation than the real data, and dead states are placed on the final evidence, so evidence results here are an upper bound, never real evidence

synthetic_iid.role: mechanism only: i.i.d. 93% correct observations, the assumption behind the accepted lambda=4 default; dead states not aligned with the evidence
